{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter to completed orders only
completed = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute the mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print the result
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue}')"}
